description: North Western Province - Delegating the power vested with the Commissioner and the Registrar of Co-operative Development of the North Western Provincial Council to Mr. Hitihami Mudiyanselage Dharmasena with effect from 18.01.2015 and to Mr. Gamage Somadasa with effect from 01.02.2015
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (J. P. Dayasiri Pathmakumara Jayasekera) with his detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities ("Minister-in-charge of the subject of Finance and Planning Law and Peace, Local Government and Manpower, Education and Cultural Affairs, Land, Environment, Tourism, Investment Co-ordinate, Co-operative and Food Supply and Distribution"). It also contains a delegation of powers to other named individuals (Hitihami Mudiyanselage Dharmasena and Gamage Somadasa), making it a hybrid document that includes both government personnel and detailed administrative responsibilities.
